reddit.title: Explore the New Territories in Provincia's Conquest Mode!
reddit.body: In our latest update, we've introduced a campaign mode with a locked home basin and five new territories to conquer. Each territory offers unique rewards and challenges, with fog covering unexplored areas until you march forward. Check out the details and strategy tips in our devtalk! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: New Campaign Mode: Conquest!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce the introduction of a new campaign mode in Provincia! Start your journey in a locked home basin and work your way through five adjacent territories, each with its own set of rewards and unique challenges. Discover the strategies needed to conquer them in our latest devtalk. Read all about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
